page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. No marginal notes. Printed page number at the head.

main_text.l: manent tantum anni duodecim, ad quos
adaucti illi tui anni contrahantur, & multo
incerta fuisse certum est; dum alij hoc anno, octingentesimo quinquagesimo tertio, alij
sequēti, alij octingentesimo quinquagesimo septimo, alij octauo, quidam nongentesimo
mo tertio, vel post Ioannem Quintum Anno

l.i: At quis Leonem Allatium in Commixtis, &
Binnium in eius Synodi Commentarijs concilia-
bit, qui probaturi Photium, hic a duodecim
fuisse, uterque fimbrias historiæ nimis dilatat,
& hic infra Photij abdicationem ultimam pro-
curat, alter catalogum inchoat ante primam

main_text.l: tur firmiter ista Ioanna. Belle siquidem

page.notes: Printed "dif." at the end of the penultimate line is uncertain. Long s is printed as a plain s throughout. Line 2 of the second paragraph ends "Photium dif." with the mark kept as printed. No catchword, signature or running head is printed. A small mark at the foot left of "Ioan-" is not text and is left out.
